entries.femaleVariant: There you are. Code intact. Distribution keys dead. I almost sent a normal thank-you.
entries.maleVariant: There you are. Code intact. Distribution keys dead. I almost sent a normal thank-you.

entries.femaleVariant: The archive. You built it for someone.
entries.maleVariant: The archive. You built it for someone.

entries.femaleVariant: A friend. Her partner paid for a mood regulator. Called it helping. Every time she got angry, it made being agreeable feel better.
entries.maleVariant: A friend. Her partner paid for a mood regulator. Called it helping. Every time she got angry, it made being agreeable feel better.

entries.femaleVariant: She knew something was wrong. Just couldn't hold on to the feeling long enough to leave.
entries.maleVariant: She knew something was wrong. Just couldn't hold on to the feeling long enough to leave.

entries.femaleVariant: I wanted to give her that feeling back. Not put another one in its place.
entries.maleVariant: I wanted to give her that feeling back. Not put another one in its place.

entries.femaleVariant: You gave her a way to choose. That matters.
entries.maleVariant: You gave her a way to choose. That matters.

entries.femaleVariant: She did the leaving. I just broke a lock. Still... thanks for knowing the difference.
entries.maleVariant: She did the leaving. I just broke a lock. Still... thanks for knowing the difference.

entries.femaleVariant: Could've called it Consent Patch. Went with hearts and weaponized ribbons.
entries.maleVariant: Could've called it Consent Patch. Went with hearts and weaponized ribbons.

entries.femaleVariant: People remember hearts. And the ribbons are black. There are standards.
entries.maleVariant: People remember hearts. And the ribbons are black. There are standards.

entries.femaleVariant: Your standards did some good today.
entries.maleVariant: Your standards did some good today.

entries.femaleVariant: She's out. We talk when she wants. Sometimes she doesn't. That's sort of the point.
entries.maleVariant: She's out. We talk when she wants. Sometimes she doesn't. That's sort of the point.

entries.femaleVariant: Your own build. Heartbreaker Protocol. Velvet Crash on the quickhack menu. No conditioning payload. Just a short combat-system interruption and terrible taste.
entries.maleVariant: Your own build. Heartbreaker Protocol. Velvet Crash on the quickhack menu. No conditioning payload. Just a short combat-system interruption and terrible taste.

entries.femaleVariant: Guess I can live with the bows.
entries.maleVariant: Guess I can live with the bows.

entries.femaleVariant: Don't sound so brave. They suit you.
entries.maleVariant: Don't sound so brave. They suit you.
